newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Delhaize sees profit, sales growth in '97.
newsitem.headline: Delhaize sees profit, sales growth in '97.

text.p: Belgian retail group Etablissements Delhaize Freres et Cie "Le Lion" SA said on Wednesday it expected sales and profits to grow further in 1997, and planned 14 billion Belgian francs of investments this year.

"In 1997 113 new sales outlets will be opened. This together with the takeover of the 100 Kash n' Karry supermarkets acquired at the end of 1996 by (U.S. unit) Food Lion enables the Delhaize "Le Lion" group to look forward to continued growth in sales and profits," it said in a statement on 1996 results.
